s: Dinim hannohagim bibhemot beyom tob ubo d' seipim: zebubim hannitlim bibhema — muttar lahasiran mimmenna beyom tob, ap al pi sheal yede ken naasa bah chabbura, mikkol maqom kevan shehu eno mitkavven laasot chabbura — muttar, kevan shezzehu dabar sheeno mukrach sheyyaaseh bah chabbura, shehare lipamim en chabbura naasa al yede kak.

En megordin habbehema bemagredet beyom tob, mippene shemmashsheret sear, vechayyab mishshum gozez. Veap al pi shehu eno mitkavven lehashshir sear, mikkol maqom kevan shehu dabar mukrach dikshemmegared bemagredet hu mashshir sear — hare zeh asur, kemo shennitbaer besimman sh"k ayyen sham.

En meyalledin et habbehema beyom tob, dehaynu sheasur limshok havvalad min harechem. Abal masidin otah beledatah, dehaynu sheochez bavvalad shello yippol laaretz. Venopeach lo bechotmo, venoten lo dad letok piv.

Behema tehora sherichaqa veladah — muttar lezallep alayv me shilyatah (perush sheshshorin et hashshilya bemayim) velitten melo egrop melach berachmah kede sheyyikob lah vetizkor tzaar halleda uterachem alayv. Abal asur laasot ken libhema temea, lepi shehu toreach beyom tob bechinnam, sheen zeh moil kelum libhema temea, sheenah meqarabto leolam achar sherichaqattu.
